note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the C1 Ariete. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. It publishes the mass, the overall length, width and height, the ground clearance, the engine model and swept volume, the engine rating of 1,270 hp with no net basis, the forward gear count, the maximum road speed and the road range. It publishes no track shoe width, no track pitch and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
